product: Detect CSV delimiters in Lakeflow Designer (Public Preview)
tagline: When you add a CSV file, Lakeflow Designer samples it to detect comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe delimiters.
what_it_does: When you add a CSV file, Lakeflow Designer samples it to detect comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe delimiters. You can set the delimiter manually when detection does not match your file. You can bring any data accessible through Databricks into a visual data prep in Lakeflow Designer.
why_it_matters: Additionally, for large amounts of data, this provides the best performance.
plain_summary: When you add a CSV file, Lakeflow Designer samples it to detect comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe delimiters. You can set the delimiter manually when detection does not match your file.
key_takeaway: When you add a CSV file, Lakeflow Designer samples it to detect comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe delimiters.
